problems: Minyue used six pages against a budget of five: Emperor Wu of Han was opened for the dong-ou dossier and settles the 135 (Nanyue invasion, dual monarchy) and 110 (surrender, resettlement) dates that the Minyue page leaves open.

Minyue starts 306 (infobox) while the yue dossier ends Yue in 333 and Cliopatria starts Minyue in 333: Fujian has no state in 333-307. Minyue and Yue share Q1936158 but are different states (stated in both dossiers).
Minyue ends 110 (infobox, Emperor Wu page) against Cliopatria's 111: minyue_-110 is a new one-year keyframe.
Cliopatria's Zhongshan shapes share no grid cell with the core the Zhongshan page names; both are verdict wrong. The core discs match those in the wei and zhao dossiers.

Mirrors owed: qin-dynasty (occupation 214-206 counterpart minyue), han-dynasty (vassal 202-110, contest 111-110, gain 110 for minyue and dong-ou), nanyue (contest 135 counterpart minyue); wei and zhao already mirror zhongshan.
